remarks: Enjoy comfortable, low-maintenance living in this updated 2-bedroom condo at Fountain Terrace, a gated community in the heart of Stamford. Located on the 5th floor with a private balcony, this bright and move-in ready unit offers a functional open layout, abundant natural light, generous closet space, newer kitchen appliances including a dishwasher, and two A/C units included. Rent includes heat, hot water, cooking gas, water, trash removal, snow removal, landscaping, and one assigned parking space, making monthly living simple and predictable. Residents enjoy elevator access, seasonal swimming pool, fitness center, community room, bicycle storage, basement storage, card-operated laundry, guest parking, and gated security. Ideally located minutes to downtown Stamford, Metro-North train station, restaurants, shopping, parks, and major commuter routes including I-95. A great opportunity to enjoy convenience, amenities, and easy access to everything Stamford has to offer.
